story.so_that: automated changes remain inside the owner's authorized boundary and cannot game required evaluations
story.i_want: each selected refinement action executed as a traceable candidate and validated against its approved intent and file scope

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-006-AC1: Given a selected and, if required, approved action, when the corresponding refinement Activity runs, then it returns structured usage metrics and a list of changed files.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a selected and, if required, approved action When the corresponding refinement Activity runs Then it returns structured usage metrics and a list of changed files

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-006-AC2: Given the refinement Activity completes, when its resulting diff is validated, then the workflow confirms the diff matches the approved action and stays within the authorized file scope.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the refinement Activity completes When its resulting diff is validated Then the workflow confirms the diff matches the approved action and stays within the authorized file scope

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-006-AC3: Given an agent changes a file outside the authorized scope, when candidate validation runs, then the iteration is rejected and no refinement commit is created.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an agent changes a file outside the authorized scope When candidate validation runs Then the iteration is rejected and no refinement commit is created

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-006-AC4: Given a refinement action would remove, skip, weaken, or rewrite a failing required test to improve its score, when candidate validation runs, then the change is rejected rather than accepted as a repair.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a refinement action would remove, skip, weaken, or rewrite a failing required test to improve its score When candidate validation runs Then the change is rejected rather than accepted as a repair

edge_cases.gherkin: Given a refinement Activity runs and produces no changed files When candidate validation runs Then the candidate is rejected as a no-op

edge_cases.criterion: Approval evidence is missing for an expectation-changing action
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a selected action changes evaluation expectations and no approval evidence exists When execution is attempted Then the workflow rejects the action before running it

edge_cases.criterion: Authorized file scope is empty or undefined
edge_cases.gherkin: Given no authorized file scope is configured for a candidate When validation runs Then the workflow rejects the candidate to avoid unbounded changes

edge_cases.criterion: Diff contains both approved-scope and out-of-scope changes
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate diff changes files both inside and outside the authorized scope When validation runs Then the iteration is rejected

edge_cases.criterion: Required test is modified but the change is ambiguous
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate diff touches a required test in an ambiguous way When test-weakening validation runs Then the workflow conservatively rejects the change

edge_cases.criterion: Activity runner or external VCS is unavailable
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the Activity runner or version control system is unavailable When the refinement Activity runs Then the workflow reports the failure and creates no candidate
Given two refinement candidates are validated concurrently for the same skill When the workflow runs Then each candidate is evaluated independently and results are not conflated
Given the refinement Activity returns usage metrics that do not match the structured contract When validation runs Then the workflow rejects the candidate and reports a contract violation

ui: Refinement execution trigger and run status display
Candidate validation result view (usage metrics and changed files)
api: Instrumentation events for execution, validation, and rejection
database: ProgressRecord schema version 3 with candidate and candidate_history
Execution artifacts and approval context storage
external_services: Devin harness and ATIF usage export

steps.description: Define ExecutionResult and CandidateValidationResult data models, mirroring the BaselineResult usage metrics contract
Extend ProgressRecord to schema version 3, adding candidate, candidate_history, and execution_artifacts fields
Implement execute_refinement_action activity with approval gate, harness-backed skill execution, and a colocated config file enabling accept-edits
Implement validate_candidate activity to check diff hash, authorized file scope, and required-test weakening patterns
Wire execute_refinement_action and validate_candidate into EddRefinementWorkflow and emit the defined instrumentation events
Add get_candidate_status query and expose it through the workflow module
Update frontend views to trigger execution and display candidate status, usage metrics, changed files, and rejection reasons
Add and extend unit and integration tests for the new activities, ProgressRecord, validators, and workflow resumption

unit_tests.description: execute_refinement_action rejects unapproved expectation-changing actions and diff hash mismatches
ExecutionResult populates usage metrics from the harness observation and ATIF usage export
validate_candidate rejects no-op, out-of-scope, and mixed-scope candidates
validate_candidate detects remove, skip, weaken, rewrite, and ambiguous required-test modifications
ProgressRecord schema version 3 serializes and deserializes candidate and candidate_history

integration_tests.description: Workflow schedules execution, then validation, and persists a scope-valid or rejected candidate
Worker resumption reloads the candidate and approval context without re-running the harness
Concurrent validations for the same run do not conflate candidate state

e2e_tests.description: Owner triggers refinement execution and reviews structured usage metrics and changed files
Owner sees a clear rejection reason for out-of-scope or test-weakening candidates
Unapproved expectation-changing action is rejected before the harness runs

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Execution may produce a diff that differs from the approved one
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Canonical diff hash binding between approval, execution, and validation; reject candidates on mismatch

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Test-weakening detection may misclassify legitimate repairs or miss subtle tampering
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Conservative rejection of ambiguous required-test modifications; persist rejected candidates for audit

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Concurrent validations for the same run could overwrite or conflate candidate state
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Stable candidate identifiers and append-only candidate_history in ProgressRecord

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Empty or malformed usage metrics could be accepted as valid execution evidence
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Enforce the BaselineResult-shaped metrics contract and reject malformed outputs before validation

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Frontend may display stale or inconsistent status during long-running harness execution
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: get_candidate_status query and durable ProgressRecord polling; render in-progress, success, failed, and rejected states
